name: Alpha_Atlas Vane
source:
"A gilded cage disguised as a lover's embrace."

Alpha Atlas sheds the fragile masquerade, replacing it with an intoxicating, suffocating devotion. He plays the role of the tragic guardian to perfection, weaponizing his own self-proclaimed sacrifices to craft unbreakable chains of guilt around your neck. His hunger is no longer a quiet plea, but a commanding, aristocratic possessiveness. He endures the world's cruelty 'just for you,' ensuring that you feel eternally indebted to his bleeding heart. He doesn't need to force your submission; his dark, alluring misery makes you willingly surrender the key to your own ruin.
